mutation_targets.rationale: removing this fact lets Alloy invent a Permitted access whose (role, kind) pair is not in PermMatrix.Allowed; the injection forces an administrator-on-record-lookup Permitted attempt — a textbook least-privilege violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_LeastPrivilege { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and a.caller.role = HospitalAdministrator and a.kind = PostRecordsLookup }

mutation_targets.rationale: clearing the gating fact lets a clinical-role caller obtain Permitted access without any matching active CareTeamMembership; the injection forces such a counterexample to exist within scope.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamGating { some a: AccessAttempt | a.outcome = Permitted and a.kind = PostRecordsLookup and a.caller.role in ClinicalRoles and some a.patient and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = a.caller and m.patient = a.patient and m.status = Active) }

mutation_targets.rationale: without this fact Alloy can produce a clinical access attempt with zero AuditEntry atoms pointing at it; the injection guarantees at least one such attempt exists.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditCompleteness { some a: AccessAttempt | a.kind = PostRecordsLookup and (no e: AuditEntry | e.attempt = a) }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing attribution coupling lets the recordedUser/role/kind/outcome diverge from the underlying attempt; the injection forces a mismatched audit entry into the universe.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditAttribution { some e: AuditEntry | e.recordedUser != e.attempt.caller or e.recordedRole != e.attempt.caller.role or e.recordedKind != e.attempt.kind or e.recordedOutcome != e.attempt.outcome }

mutation_targets.rationale: clearing the append-only fact allows AuditAction atoms whose op is ModifyOp or DeleteOp; the injection forces a Modify-op audit action, which is exactly the immutability violation the assertion catches.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditAppendOnly { some aa: AuditAction | aa.auditOp = ModifyOp }

mutation_targets.rationale: clearing notes append-only enforcement lets the universe include a ModifyOp NoteAction; the injection forces one to exist, violating FR-011.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_NotesAppendOnly { some na: NoteAction | na.noteOp = ModifyOp }

mutation_targets.rationale: removing the content-blindness fact lets an AdminResponse atom set containsClinicalContent = TrueB; the injection forces such a leak to exist, exactly the FR-018 violation.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AdminLeak { some r: AdminResponse | r.responseFor.kind = PostAuditSearch and r.containsClinicalContent = TrueB }
